content: Customer Rohan Deshmukh called insurance agent Karan Joshi to cancel his health insurance policy (HP-2024-5678) because his new employer provides coverage. The agent initiated the cancellation, confirmed it will take 24 hours to reflect, and explained that a prorated refund will be issued to the customer's bank account within 5 to 7 business days. A confirmation email will also be sent.

action_items: Calculate and issue prorated refund within 5-7 business days
Send a confirmation email to the customer
